name: TOWER SEMICONDUCTOR LTD.

ads_ratio.source: Tower Semiconductor Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (SEC filing, CIK 928876), Item 9: 'Our ordinary shares are listed and traded on the NASDAQ Stock Market ... and on the TASE under the symbol TSEM' — the security registered under Section 12 is the ordinary shares themselves, listed directly on Nasdaq; there is no depositary/ADS program.
ads_ratio.reason: Direct-listed foreign private issuer: one Nasdaq-traded TSEM share is one ordinary share, so per-share figures from the filings and the traded price are on the same basis and no ADS scaling applies. Declared under step 8(d) bounded authority from the filer's own 20-F.
